audit.whatIsWrong: Level 3 and 2+ items read Skill on both layers where the packet chart and the mirror give both rows to Ziggs.
audit.why: Packet chart is Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Gwen, Gwen, Ziggs, and the mirror realigned its own layers to match. Ziggs holds five of seven rows; Gwen owns Level 6 and first item.
audit.corrected: Rows 2 and 6 flipped on both layers together, ratings raised to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as your Mega Inferno Bomb spike on a row that belongs to Gwen, with no cooldowns anywhere.
audit.why: Needlework is 120/100/80s at 1200 range and can be recast twice; Hallowed Mist 22s at rank 1; Skip 'n Slash 13s at 400 and partially refunded when she connects; Snip Snip! 6.5s down to 3.5s at 450. Your Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1 and Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16s, with reduced damage on repeat detonations against the same target.
audit.corrected: Level 6 now names Needlework and Skip 'n Slash with their real timers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said Needlework gives her a dash, in three separate fields, and treated Hallowed Mist as blanket untargetability.
audit.why: Needlework is a thrown needle at 1200 range that slows and can be cast up to two more times — it has no dash. The dash is Skip 'n Slash (E), 400 range, which also grants attack speed, bonus attack range and magic damage on-hit. And Hallowed Mist protects her only from enemies outside it: anyone who enters the mist can target her, which is the actual counterplay and was never stated. Separately, Snip Snip!'s centre deals true damage and A Thousand Cuts heals her off champion damage, so neither MR nor waiting out the chip is the answer.
audit.corrected: Correct dash attribution, the enter-the-mist counterplay, the true-damage centre, the on-hit scaling and the Grievous Wounds requirement.

edits.before: Mega Inferno Bomb online — any chipped target or crashing wave is now your gold. Hold it for the sub-60% HP window.
edits.after: Needlework (R) is 120s at rank 1 and hits from 1200; Skip 'n Slash (E) is the dash, 13s and refunded on hit.

edits.before: Level 3 her W Mist only helps when committed, so you stay ahead.
edits.after: Level 3: step into Hallowed Mist and she is targetable again.

edits.before: At Level 6 her R dash and W Mist let her skirmish untouchable.
edits.after: At 6 Needlework's three needles chunk you from 1200 range.

edits.before: On her first item Q Snip Snip DPS and Mist windows power her all-in.
edits.after: On her first item, Snip Snip!'s centre true damage ignores MR.

edits.before: Gwen's R Needlework plus W Mist turns the corner: she dashes in, drops W to negate your ranged damage, and skirmishes untouchable inside the cloud, so W Satchel yourself out the instant she engages.
edits.after: Her dash is Skip 'n Slash (E), 400 range on 13s and refunded when she connects — Needlework (R) is a 1200-range needle, not a dash. Hallowed Mist only blocks enemies outside it: step in and she is targetable again.

edits.before: With Nashor's or a component Gwen's Q Snip Snip DPS and W Mist windows let her all-in through your poke; keep your distance, save W Satchel for her dash, and don't fight while she's standing in the Mist.
edits.after: With Nashor's, Snip Snip! (Q) deals true damage in the centre, so MR is the wrong lever — and Skip 'n Slash (E) applies on-hit, so armour reads the trade wrong too. A Thousand Cuts heals her: buy Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Level 5-6 flips to Gwen as R Needlework gives her a dash and W Mist lets her sit inside a cloud your ranged damage can't touch; respect the all-in, hold W Satchel for her engage, and don't trade while she's in the Mist.
edits.after: Level 5-6 flips to Gwen: Needlework (R) throws up to three needles from 1200 and Skip 'n Slash (E) is the dash. Hallowed Mist (W) is 22s at rank 1 and stops only enemies outside it — walk in, or wait it out rather than firing into it.

edits.before: Hold W Satchel to escape her R dash engage
edits.after: Hold Satchel Charge for her Skip 'n Slash

edits.before: Dash in with R Needlework and drop W to negate your poke
edits.after: Skip 'n Slash in, then drop Hallowed Mist on herself

edits.before: Skirmish inside Hallowed Mist where ranged damage misses
edits.after: Making you fire into the Mist instead of stepping in

notes: The packet's suspectName 'Snip Snip' is a near-miss on the real 'Snip Snip!' — the exclamation mark is part of the name, and the corrected text restores it. The 'Needlework gives her a dash' error appeared in three fields and drove the level-6 advice. Not asserted: whether Satchel Charge's knockback can displace Gwen out of her own Hallowed Mist, and whether the mines' reduced repeat-detonation damage resets if she leaves and re-enters the field.
